name: ExportPanel - Empty Current Before Storage Resolves
description: The first paint, before the storage read comes back: Current is still the empty string the page initializes it to. The Copy button renders anyway rather than waiting for data — copying an empty snapshot is a harmless no-op, whereas a button that appears once the read lands would shift under a cursor already on its way to it. This is the state that proves the button belongs to the field, not to the data.
